description.zh-CN: 性能、隐私、安全、可靠性、兼容性、可用性、可观测性和发布质量门槛。
description.en: Performance, privacy, security, reliability, compatibility, usability, observability, and release quality gates.

body.zh-CN: 呼出 P95 < 500 ms，合法预览 P95 < 300 ms，内存 < 80 MB。
body.en: Summon P95 < 500 ms, valid preview P95 < 300 ms, memory < 80 MB.

body.zh-CN: 本地优先，日志不记录 JSON 内容或 API key。
body.en: Local-first; logs never record JSON content or API keys.

body.zh-CN: v1 beta DMG/GitHub Release；更大范围分发前补签名、公证、sha256。
body.en: v1 beta DMG/GitHub Release; signing, notarization, and sha256 before broader distribution.

text.zh-CN: NFR 是 v1 可用性的底线。功能可以后置，但性能、隐私和用户可控性不能通过“稍后补文档”规避。
text.en: NFRs are the v1 usability floor. Features can be deferred, but performance, privacy, and user control cannot be bypassed with later documentation.

rows.zh-CN: 性能
rows.en: Performance

rows.zh-CN: 浮窗 P95 < 500 ms；合法 JSON preview P95 < 300 ms；unwrap 全局 200 ms 超时。
rows.en: Window P95 < 500 ms; valid JSON preview P95 < 300 ms; unwrap has a global 200 ms timeout.

rows.zh-CN: 手动 macOS 验证 + 单元测试覆盖纯函数。
rows.en: Manual macOS verification plus unit tests for pure functions.

rows.zh-CN: 内存
rows.en: Memory

rows.zh-CN: 稳态 < 80 MB。
rows.en: Steady state < 80 MB.

rows.zh-CN: Activity Monitor / devtools sampling。
rows.en: Activity Monitor / devtools sampling.

rows.zh-CN: 隐私
rows.en: Privacy

rows.zh-CN: JSON 内容、历史、设置、secrets 默认本地；AI 请求仅由用户主动触发。
rows.en: JSON content, history, settings, and secrets stay local by default; AI requests are only user-triggered.

rows.zh-CN: 日志审计和 AI request path review。
rows.en: Log audit and AI request path review.

rows.zh-CN: 安全
rows.en: Security

rows.zh-CN: secrets.json 限制文件权限；日志和 IPC event 不带 API key。
rows.en: secrets.json uses restricted permissions; logs and IPC events carry no API key.

rows.zh-CN: 存储与日志 spec 检查。
rows.en: Storage and logging spec checks.

rows.zh-CN: 兼容
rows.en: Compatibility

rows.zh-CN: macOS 11+，arm64/x86_64；Windows installer 为后续分发准备。
rows.en: macOS 11+, arm64/x86_64; Windows installer is prepared for later distribution.

rows.zh-CN: 平台构建和手动 smoke。
rows.en: Platform build and manual smoke.

rows.zh-CN: 可访问
rows.en: Accessibility

rows.zh-CN: 键盘可完成核心流程；语言支持 English / 简体中文。
rows.en: Keyboard can complete core flow; language supports English / Simplified Chinese.

rows.zh-CN: 键盘 walkthrough 和 i18n smoke。
rows.en: Keyboard walkthrough and i18n smoke.

rows.zh-CN: 可靠性
rows.en: Reliability

rows.zh-CN: 损坏恢复需要明确策略；当前作为 P1 backlog。
rows.en: Corruption recovery needs an explicit strategy and remains P1 backlog.

rows.zh-CN: spec/10 与 spec/15 补齐后验收。
rows.en: Accept after spec/10 and spec/15 are completed.

rows.zh-CN: 发布
rows.en: Release

rows.zh-CN: DMG < 15 MB；更大范围分发需要签名、公证、稳定资产 URL、sha256。
rows.en: DMG < 15 MB; broader distribution needs signing, notarization, stable asset URL, and sha256.

rows.zh-CN: release scripts + GitHub Release checks。
rows.en: release scripts plus GitHub Release checks.

body.zh-CN: 不要把 Keychain 重新作为 Jsonita API key 的产品存储路径；当前契约是本地 secrets.json + 权限控制。
body.en: Do not reintroduce Keychain as the Jsonita API-key product storage path; the current contract is local secrets.json plus permission control.

items.zh-CN: 日志只记录事件、错误类别、耗时和路径，不记录用户 JSON 正文。
items.en: Logs record events, error categories, duration, and paths, not user JSON body.

items.zh-CN: AI Fix request 只发送当前待修复内容，且必须由用户动作触发。
items.en: AI Fix request only sends the current repair target and must be triggered by user action.

items.zh-CN: 导出日志和删除数据必须保留用户可控入口。
items.en: Log export and data deletion must remain user-controllable.

items.zh-CN: Rust JSON engine、AI extract_json、settings/storage migration 做单元测试。
items.en: Unit-test Rust JSON engine, AI extract_json, and settings/storage migration.

items.zh-CN: 文档改动运行 docs:check 与 verify_doc_links。
items.en: Documentation changes run docs:check and verify_doc_links.

items.zh-CN: 实现或 Tauri 配置改动运行 pnpm tsc、pnpm build、cargo check/test 的相关子集。
items.en: Implementation or Tauri config changes run the relevant subset of pnpm tsc, pnpm build, cargo check/test.

rows.zh-CN: NFR 页面过去不是双语 CAST HTML。
rows.en: The NFR page was previously not bilingual CAST HTML.

rows.zh-CN: 可能影响交付或用户信任。
rows.en: May affect delivery or user trust.

rows.zh-CN: 本次迁移为 plan/04_nfr.json -> plan/04_nfr.html，并纳入 freshness check。
rows.en: This migration makes it plan/04_nfr.json -> plan/04_nfr.html and includes it in freshness checks.

items.zh-CN: 打开 plan/04_nfr.html 时能切换中英双语。
所有 NFR 项都有对应验证或 TODO。
items.en: Every NFR item has corresponding verification or TODO.

questions.zh-CN: SQLite/settings/window 损坏恢复契约仍需细化。
questions.en: SQLite/settings/window corruption recovery contract still needs refinement.
